class.name: CbGrip
class.brief_description: Where the other hand holds an item: a marker in the item's scene.
class.description: An item is carried at its origin by one hand. With a CbGrip in its scene, the character's other arm is bent so that its wrist is on the marker, wherever the carrying hand and the animation take the item, while that other hand is empty. Baked with the item's [CbItemBody] (a [code]grip[/code] line in [code]items/<kind>.cfg[/code]), so the server poses the same arms for its hit tests and every player sees them. One per item.

members.member: The hand also turns as the marker is turned: as a hand carrying an item placed here would be (the marker's -Z is where such an item would point). Off: the hand keeps the turn its animation gives it.
